title: Thai Green Curry Soup with Tofu, Noodles, Mushrooms & Green Beans

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, curry paste, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms start to soften, 1-2 minutes.
Add broth to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the soup is boiling, uncover, add tofu and rice noodles, then stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are almost soft, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
When the noodles are almost soft, add green beans. Continue to cook until noodles and beans are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
Wash, dry, and juice lime into the soup. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Enjoy!
